verdict.rationale: Omnara has no documented native way to assign a task from an issue or ticket. The pieces exist to build one: an agent can be given a Linear MCP server to read and act on tickets, and agents can be launched programmatically through the REST API, CLI or SDK, which could be wired to an issue tracker. That makes this a do-it-yourself integration, not a built-in workflow. Missing for 10: a first-party issue/ticket trigger (e.g. assign from Linear, Jira or GitHub issues), documentation of an issue-to-task workflow, and any hands-on corroboration.
